messages:
anna: Quick sync — we need a token unit-econ dashboard for Console: cost per 1k tokens, cache & batch savings breakdown, per-route and per-model. Who can own infra inputs?
kevin: infra can add low-cardinality counters + histograms. We'll need token_emitted_total, token_cached_total, batch_size_histogram, model_gpu_ms_sum, model_gpu_ms_count. :+1:
maria: runtime can emit those. Important: add request labels: customer_id (hashed), route_id, priority. We'll also emit trace_id for sampling. We try to keep label cardinality low.
olivia: analytics: can compute $/1k tokens if we have tokens + cost numerator. Need canonical gpu_cost_per_second and egress_per_mb. Who owns those constants?
sam: product: want per-route and per-team rollups, and a toggle to show "including cache savings". Also show projected savings if we enable caching for X%.
kevin: ownership: infra owns gpu_cost_per_second (from billing) and export to metrics as 'infra_gpu_cost_rate_seconds' gauge. Egress cost from cloud-billing exporter.
maria: sample PromQL to compute tokens per second and cache hit rate:
```
sum(rate(token_emitted_total[5m])) by (model) as tokens_ps
sum(rate(token_cached_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(token_emitted_total[5m])) by (model) as cache_hit
```
then cost estimate:
```
gpu_seconds = sum(rate(model_gpu_ms_sum[5m])) / 1000
gpu_cost = gpu_seconds * infra_gpu_cost_rate_seconds
cost_per_1k = (gpu_cost + egress_cost - cache_savings) / (sum(rate(token_emitted_total[5m]))/1000)
```
maria: caveat: model_gpu_ms_sum is heavy, consider summarizing by rollout or sampling.
olivia: for per-customer chargebacks we need to keep customer_id label; hashing ok. For big customers we might need full cardinality—sampling won't cut it.
kevin: proposal: emit full labels for 'billing_tag' only when request has billing metadata, otherwise use 'unknown'. Also provide a sampled trace stream for replaying to estimate batch behavior.
sam: UX: display time-range selector, show 'estimated $/1k tokens' + popover with formula and assumptions. Add 'show simulated savings' button.
anna: admin: add rollout plan — phase 1: infra + runtime metrics (2w), analytics formula + nightly job (2w), console panels + UX (1w). Feature-flag the console. Assign owners: kevin infra, maria runtime, olivia analytics, sam product.
kevin: noted. I'll open infra PR to add metrics and a prom exporter config. We'll target canary in staging first.
maria: will add tags and sampling in runtime; will include a small buffered exporter to avoid perf impact. :rocket:
olivia: will write the canonical SQL in the analytics repo and a job to emit daily per-customer $/1k.
sam: will mockups in Figma and share link: https://redwood.design/figma/token-econ (placeholder)
deploy-bot: deploy notification: metrics-exporter v2 deployed to staging at 1750002000 :white_check_mark:
kevin: staging looks good, slight label throttling — turning on sampling for route=webhook.
anna: perfect. Action items + due dates in a follow-up doc. Thanks all :heart:
kevin: thumbs up
maria: ack
olivia: ack
sam: ack
